summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would reduce the number of laws that require forms to be set by regulations.
It would replace those forms with other approaches, such as letting regulations directly state the requirements or letting ministers approve forms through notifiable instruments.
The bill also includes minor technical amendments to support the changed provisions, such as application provisions clarifying when the old form requirements stop.
changes: Reduce the number of provisions requiring forms prescribed by regulations.
Replace prescribed forms with direct regulatory requirements or minister-approved notifiable instruments.
Make minor consequential and technical amendments to support the changed provisions.
summary.affected: People and organisations that interact with Commonwealth laws requiring prescribed forms.
